title: Complaints about a practitioner
blurb: A complaint about the conduct or competence of somebody practising. This one cannot be made anonymously.

questions.label: This complaint cannot be anonymous. Do you want to go on?
questions.help: A complaint about a named person that nobody will stand behind cannot be acted on, so this logbook asks who you are and seals it with the rest of your answers. It is not published — publication is a separate question later — but it cannot be taken back out of the record afterwards.

questions.label: What is your part in this?
options: I was the patient or client
I am their family or representative
I work alongside the person complained about
I am a regulator or employer

questions.label: Who is the complaint about?
questions.help: Their name, and their role if you know it.

questions.label: Their registration or licence number, if you know it
What is the complaint about?
options: Competence or the standard of care
Conduct towards a patient or client

questions.label: When did it happen?
questions.help: The date it happened, or the first date if it went on for a while.

questions.label: Where?
questions.help: The practice, clinic, ward or address.

questions.label: Have you raised this anywhere else?
What happened?
questions.help: In your own words, in the order it happened. Say what was said and done, by whom, and what you saw yourself rather than what you concluded.

questions.label: Do you have documents, photographs or recordings about this?
questions.help: Nothing is uploaded by answering this. It only tells us something exists, so we can ask you for it if it turns out to matter.
